features.name: Project Management Module
features.description: Odoo Project customization for renovation: stages model (demolition, electrical, plumbing, plaster, screed, tiles, painting, finishing), Gantt view, checklist-based completion

features.name: Auth & Security Module
features.description: JWT auth with httpOnly cookies, RBAC (viewer/owner/contractor/worker/admin), role NOT accepted in register, startup validation crash on missing secrets

features.name: Camera Management Module
features.description: Camera model, RTSP stream configuration, snapshot capture service (cron every 15 min), MinIO storage, camera status tracking

features.name: CV Pipeline (Stage Detection)
features.description: YOLOv8-based renovation stage classifier, Redis queue consumer, stage progress update via JSON-RPC, confidence threshold filtering

features.name: Client Portal
features.description: Odoo website portal: project timeline with photos, stage progress bars, budget overview, timelapse viewer, public share page

features.name: Timelapse Generator
features.description: FFmpeg-based daily/weekly timelapse video generation from snapshots, Redis queue consumer, MinIO storage, share token generation

features.name: Budget Tracker
features.description: Estimate vs actual budget comparison using Decimal type, cost categories, budget alerts, integration with Odoo Accounting

features.name: AI Alerts System
features.description: Crew absence detection (no snapshots 24h+), budget overrun alerts (>110%), schedule delay prediction from CV progress, Telegram notifications

features.name: Payment Integration (ЮKassa)
features.description: Subscription model (basic/pro/business), ЮKassa webhook with HMAC verification, Decimal for all amounts, idempotent webhook processing

features.name: Referral System
features.description: Unique referral codes, share timelapse → earn 7 free days, referral tracking, bonus activation on referred user subscription
